title: Elite surfers to test Cloud 9 waves at WSL Philippines Pro Tour
summary: Some of the world's best surfers will be in action when the Philippines hosts the World Surf League (WSL) Pro Championship Tour at Cloud 9 in Siargao starting on October 30.
